**Finding submitted: LOL-CAP — missing (fallback cure inserted).**

- **Investigation:** No limitation-of-liability, aggregate-liability, or consequential-damages language exists anywhere. Section 9 (Warranties) holds only mutual corporate-authority representations plus the Globix acknowledgement; Section 10 (General Provisions) runs Notices → Headings with no cap; the only "liability" hits (p0061, p0062) are No Joint Venture boilerplate. Searches for "damages/consequential/indirect" and "indemnif" returned nothing.
- **Result:** Both parties are exposed to unlimited liability, so the rule's expected clause is genuinely absent.
- **Cure:** One `insert_after` at p0070 adding Section 10.9 — a mutual aggregate cap at fees paid or payable by the Company in the 12 months preceding the claim, with Excluded Claims (indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence, wilful misconduct) uncapped. All six fallback elements are met by that single operation; preferred-only extras (USD 1,000,000 floor, mutual consequential exclusion, fraud/IP/data-security carve-outs, payment-obligation exclusion) were deliberately not volunteered.
